wiki.title: Ralph Norman
wiki.extract: Ralph Warren Norman Jr. (born June 20, 1953) is an American politician and real estate developer who has served as the U.S. representative for South Carolina's 5th congressional district since 2017. His district includes most of the South Carolina side of the Charlotte metropolitan area, along with outer portions of the Upstate and Midlands. Norman's tenure in Congress will end in January 2027 after unsuccessful gubernatorial and U.S. Senate bids.
